Clinch night window: Midtown, Thu 10 Jun 2027

On the schedule, not yet possible. Game 6 of the Finals is played on Thursday 10 June only if the series needs it. Nothing is offered for this night unless the series reaches a game that can close it.

Why this night is watched: On past clinch and title nights, Midtown saw a sharp rise in injury calls 2 of 6 times. On an ordinary night that happens about 3 times in 100. (Our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records, 2025–2026: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj.)
